build_parser_inversecooking: build an argparse parser with all default arguments for the inversecooking model training pipeline
run_get_parser: run get_parser to parse command line arguments for training an inverse cooking model
configure_learning_rate: configure the base learning rate and lr decay rate for model training via argparse
configure_model_architecture: configure transformer layers and attention heads for the instruction and ingredient decoders
configure_inference_options: configure greedy sampling, beam search, and temperature settings for model inference
